name: Simri

queries.query: Simri Bihar cadastral parcel map official land records; Bihar BhuNaksha Simri Darbhanga
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms, the official Bihar Bhumi gateway, and the official Bihar BhuNaksha cadastral viewer. Reverse geocoding of the immutable WUP point places it in Singhwara, Darbhanga, Bihar; the BhuNaksha viewer was then inspected and queried anonymously for the matching Simri mauza route.

queries.query: सिमरी बिहार सरकारी भू-नक्शा खसरा भूमि अभिलेख दरभंगा सिंघवाड़ा
queries.result: First-party Hindi-language discovery identified the Bihar Bhumi revenue gateway and its भू-मानचित्र/भू-नक्शा service, plus the official BhuNaksha viewer. The viewer exposed Darbhanga district, Singhwara circle, and Simri mauza as selectable public map levels.

registryBasis: The Government of Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms gateway and the Directorate of Land Records and Survey's BhuNaksha viewer establish the state/district land-record and cadastral-map custodian. The live viewer exposed the local hierarchy Darbhanga > Sadar > Singhwara > Simri and public map-sheet selection. This evidences a local registry/map route, not complete citywide coverage.

officialSources.observation: Official Bihar cadastral viewer; current page JavaScript/configuration exposes REST level, map extent, plot lookup, and WMS routes.
Official Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms gateway lists भू-मानचित्र/Bhu-Naksha and land-record services.
Official Department of Revenue and Land Reforms site identifies the Directorate of Land Records and Survey and Bhu-Naksha service.

source.name: Bihar BhuNaksha / Directorate of Land Records and Survey
source.operator: Directorate of Land Records and Survey, Department of Revenue and Land Reforms, Government of Bihar; Darbhanga district / Singhwara circle route
source.method: Separate English and Hindi first-party discovery, followed by current viewer HTML/JavaScript/configuration inspection and bounded anonymous HTTPS POST/GET requests.
source.responseFormat: JSON for extent and plot lookup; HTML select fragments for hierarchy; WMS PNG for map rendering
source.nativeIdentity: Viewer returned opaque plot ID djsrFKt3RDuCV0IW8qNzMw for a bounded center probe and plot number 604; identity was not retained as a sample because no full polygon was returned.

source.compositeKeyProvenance: Viewer hierarchy codes 13,01,06,0554,RS,07,01 identify Darbhanga, Sadar, Singhwara, Simri mauza, Revisional Survey, RS Map, sheet 01; this is route provenance, not a substitute parcel identity.
source.scope: Public cadastral map route verified for Simri mauza, Singhwara circle, Darbhanga district; complete citywide parcel coverage and polygon download remain unverified.

requests.outcome: Official viewer page fetched; hidden state=10 and levelCount=7 were present.
Current JavaScript/configuration inspected. It defines REST hierarchy, extent, plot lookup, and WMS routes; no public GeoJSON parcel endpoint was found in the inspected code.
Hierarchy HTML returned. Follow-up ScalarDatahandler level requests selected district 13, sub-division 01, circle 06; Simri appeared as mauza code 0554.
Simri route exposes RS and CS survey types; RS exposes map instance 07 and sheets 01-05.
Bounded center-of-sheet probe returned safe plot identity ID=djsrFKt3RDuCV0IW8qNzMw and kide=604; no geometry was returned.

Returned plot 604 and a small native extent, plus a public report link. Only safe plot number/extent were inspected; owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account, and other unsafe fields were not requested.
Returned a small PNG map response, confirming the rendering route; raster output was not retained as parcel geometry.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Bihar state cadastral viewer with selected Darbhanga/Singhwara/Simri map-sheet route.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public map hierarchy, one RS sheet extent, one safe center probe, and WMS rendering route; no full parcel polygon or citywide coverage.

remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point transformed to approximately UTM 45N [374764.52939099976, 2897799.468369503], outside the returned RS sheet-01 extent; this is a sheet extent miss and not evidence of citywide absence. Other Simri survey sheets/routes may cover the point or locality. The viewer's anonymous plot lookup returned IDs and extents but no full polygon, and no open GeoJSON geometry route was verified. Packet completion is not source integration/admission; independent serial reviewer qualification remains required.
